page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Running head at the top centre, "DEDICATORIA." Page number and gathering mark at the foot.

main_text.p: qualicunque opella juvarem; tandem horis succisius cœpi Systema illud Metaphysicum paulo accuratius recognoscere, & ad limam revocare, ac quantum ingenii mei tenuitas passa est, expolire, expolitumque prælo subiicere.

Cogitanti autem mihi, cui has librorum meorum primitias offerrem & consecrarem, nemo ex omnibus, præter tuam, inclyte Comes, Generositatem, occurrebat, qui hanc prærogativam suo quodam iure sibi vendicaret. Tu enim Scholæ Steinfurtensis, in qua hic ingenii mei fœtus natus fuit, primus es Fundator: Tu eiusdem summus nutritius & patronus: Tu primus me ex peregrinis locis ad Philosophiæ professionem in illustri tua Schola obeundum vocasti; & ab eo tempore præcipuus semper studiorum meorum fautor fuisti: Tu denique primus typographiæ Steinfurtensis autor & institutor extitisti. Tuæ igitur illustri Generositati me-

page.notes: The mark at the top right corner ("E") is a gathering or signature mark, not a heading, and is left out. The foot mark ")(" is a gathering signature. The text ends mid-word at "me-" and continues on the next page. No catchword is printed. Spelling "prærogatiuam" is printed as such and has been normalised to "prærogativam" under the u/v rule. No illegible words.
